name: fuse
description: Claude Code mod: a burning-fuse bar above the prompt that tracks how big a turn has grown (minutes, tool calls, context growth) and holds the next tool call to ask you when a limit is hit. Runs code inside Claude Code; Claude Code only; needs 2.1.287 or later.

minutes.title: Minutes limit (default 45)
minutes.description: Clock minutes a turn may run before the next tool call is held (the clock pauses while the decision pane is open). Default and recommended: 45. Tune it from the stats file.

toolCalls.title: Tool-call limit (default 100)
toolCalls.description: Tool calls a turn may make before the next one is held. Default and recommended: 100. Tune it from the stats file.

contextGrowth.title: Context growth limit % (default 40)
contextGrowth.description: How far the context may grow in one turn, as a percent of the context window, before the next tool call is held. Default and recommended: 40. Tune it from the stats file.

maxExtensions.title: Max extensions per turn (default 2)
maxExtensions.description: How many times you may extend all limits by half in one turn; then only Stop is offered. Default and recommended: 2. Set 0 to turn Extend off.

countSubagents.title: Count subagent tool calls (default on)
countSubagents.description: Count (and hold) tool calls made inside subagents. Default and recommended: on. Off ignores subagent calls.

theme.title: Palette (default dark)
theme.description: dark or light. Default: dark; pick light on a light terminal. The API cannot tell the terminal's background, so there is no auto.

ascii.title: ASCII symbols (default off)
ascii.description: Draw the bar with . * ~ O instead of the symbols. Default: off; turn on if your font lacks them.

emoji.title: Emoji bomb (default off)
emoji.description: Draw the bomb as 💣 and the held state as 💥. Default: off.

statsPath.title: Stats file (default .claude/fuse-stats.jsonl)
statsPath.description: One JSON line per finished turn is appended here, relative to the project. Default: .claude/fuse-stats.jsonl. Keep it out of git.
